content: {"like":["The series is well crafted and well written.","It taps into the essential element for young kids that dream of being superheroes.","The mythology of the universe builds as we learn more about Grandpa Max and his time as a plumber.","Ben remains a typical 10-year-old but learns about doing the right thing and responsibilities.","The characters matured and the antagonism between Ben and Gwen replaced with genuine familial affection.","The creators were clearly comic book fans, and the Omnitrix is reminiscent of Dial H for Hero.","Ben accidentally picking the wrong alien hero is funny and teaches him to think on his feet.","The Omnitrix is green, symbol on chest of each alien, and the plumber corps being galactic defenders/policemen reminiscent of Green Lantern Corps.","The first season sets the tone and sets things in motion nicely."],"dislike":["The constant bickering and sniping between Ben and Gwen, and Gwen calling Ben names like dweeb, doofus, dork, was tiresome."]}
